sop_modules.name: Protect & Mask for Priming
sop_modules.purpose: Protect floors, windows, fixtures, and adjacent surfaces; configure masking appropriate to environment and application method.

sop_modules.name: Dust Control & Surface Conditioning
sop_modules.purpose: Control drywall dust and condition surface prior to primer to reduce fuzzing and defects.

sop_modules.name: Minor Touch-ups & Spot Repairs
sop_modules.purpose: Correct small defects before primer and between stages as quality requires.

sop_modules.name: Apply Primer
sop_modules.purpose: Apply primer coat using selected method; include backroll where specified.

sop_modules.name: Inspect, Sand (as needed), and Final Readiness
sop_modules.purpose: Inspect primed surfaces for fuzzing/defects; sand and correct per quality tier.

tasks.name: Protect floors and adjacent surfaces
tasks.notes: Active construction requires more robust protection and staging.

tasks.name: Mask for spray (openings, windows, fixtures)
tasks.notes: Required for spray methods; reduced for roll-only.

tasks.name: Vacuum dust from surfaces and ledges
tasks.notes: Critical to reduce fuzzing and adhesion issues.

tasks.name: Wipe down surfaces (as needed)
tasks.notes: More likely in higher tiers or when dust load is heavy.

tasks.name: Spot touch-up minor defects (pre-prime)
tasks.notes: Not a substitute for drywall contractor quality; keep scope limited.

tasks.name: Feather sand touch-ups
tasks.notes: Higher tiers require better feathering to reduce telegraphing.

tasks.name: Apply primer coat
tasks.notes: Spray-only may be fastest; spray+backroll improves uniformity; roll-only reduces masking but can be slower.

tasks.name: Backroll primer (when specified)
tasks.notes: Typically paired with spray; increases labor but improves penetration/uniformity.

tasks.name: Inspect primed surfaces for defects/fuzzing
tasks.notes: QL-5 inspection should assume critical lighting and higher scrutiny.

tasks.name: Spot sand fuzzing/imperfections after prime (as needed)
tasks.notes: More common at QL-4/QL-5; used selectively at QL-3.

tasks.name: Final readiness check for finish coats (handoff)
tasks.notes: This spec ends at readiness; finishes handled by separate wall/ceiling finish specs.

assumptions: This SOP library covers primer workflow only and ends with a handoff-ready condition for finish specs.
exclusions: Multiple primer coats unless explicitly added as a future variant (e.g., extreme porosity or high-build needs).
